reconcile.note: Matthew Henry reads Satan's blinding as an act God judicially permits, folding John 12:40, 2 Thessalonians 2:11-12, and 2 Corinthians 4:3-4 into one judgment.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.snippet: He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, Lest they should see with their eyes
sides.verseText: \"He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, Lest they should see with their eyes, And perceive with their heart, And would turn, And I would heal them.\"

sides.snippet: the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving
sides.verseText: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
